name: Exp_BalanceOfPower_Histogram
summary: This EA trades based on the Balance of Power (BOP) histogram indicator, which measures the strength of buyers vs sellers. It opens buy positions when BOP values are rising (buyers gaining strength) and sell positions when BOP values are falling (sellers gaining strength), with configurable smoothing applied to the indicator values.
summary_zh: 该EA基于力量平衡(BOP)直方图指标进行交易，该指标衡量买方与卖方的力量对比。当BOP值上升时开多仓，当BOP值下降时开空仓，并支持对指标值进行可配置的平滑处理。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是基于Balance of Power直方图指标的动量变化进行交易。入场条件：当BOP值连续上升（Value[0]>Value[1]且Value[1]<Value[2]）时触发买入信号，表示买方力量正在增强；当BOP值连续下降（Value[0]<Value[1]且Value[1]>Value[2]）时触发卖出信号，表示卖方力量正在增强。出场条件包括止损和止盈的硬性设置，以及反向信号触发的平仓——买入信号出现时平掉卖仓，卖出信号出现时平掉买仓。仓位管理采用多种资金管理模式，包括基于自由保证金、余额、扣除亏损后的余额等比例计算，以及固定手数模式。指标值经过可配置的平滑算法（如T3、JJMA、JurX等）处理，以减少噪音干扰。整体策略属于动量跟踪类型，跟随市场买卖力量的变化方向进场。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA trades based on momentum changes in the Balance of Power histogram indicator. Entry conditions: a buy signal is triggered when BOP values are consecutively rising (Value[0]>Value[1] and Value[1]<Value[2]), indicating buyers are gaining strength; a sell signal is triggered when BOP values are consecutively falling (Value[0]<Value[1] and Value[1]>Value[2]), indicating sellers are gaining strength. Exit conditions include hard stop-loss and take-profit settings, as well as signal-based position closing—sell positions are closed when a buy signal appears, and buy positions are closed when a sell signal appears. Position sizing supports multiple money management modes including proportional calculation based on free margin, balance, or balance minus floating loss, as well as a fixed lot mode. The indicator values are processed through configurable smoothing algorithms (such as T3, JJMA, JurX, etc.) to reduce market noise. The overall strategy is a momentum-following type, entering trades in the direction of shifting buyer-seller power dynamics.

parameters.description: 资金管理模式（自由保证金/余额/扣除亏损余额/固定手数）
parameters.description_en: Margin mode: free margin/balance/drawdown free margin/drawdown balance/fixed lot

parameters.name: BuyPosClose
parameters.description_en: Allow buy position close on reverse signal

parameters.name: SellPosClose
parameters.description_en: Allow sell position close on reverse signal

parameters.name: XPhase
parameters.description_en: Smoothing phase (-100~+100 for JJMA, different for VIDYA/AMA)

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 信号计算使用的K线索引

pros: 策略逻辑清晰，基于买卖力量对比的动量变化进行交易，具有明确的市场微观结构含义
支持多种平滑算法和资金管理模式，参数灵活可调，适应性强
同时设置了止损止盈和反向信号平仓的双重出场机制，风险控制较为完善
pros_en: Clear strategy logic based on momentum changes in buyer-seller power dynamics, with meaningful market microstructure interpretation
Supports multiple smoothing algorithms and money management modes, offering flexible parameter tuning and strong adaptability
Dual exit mechanism combining stop-loss/take-profit with signal-based position closing provides robust risk control
cons: 缺乏点差过滤和交易时段过滤，在流动性较差的时段可能产生不利成交
止损1000点、止盈2000点的默认值偏大，可能不适合所有品种和波动环境
指标仅使用单时间框架，没有多时间框架确认机制，容易产生虚假信号
缺少持仓数量检查，可能在已有同向持仓时重复开仓
cons_en: Lacks spread filter and trading session filter, which may lead to unfavorable fills during low-liquidity periods
Default stop-loss of 1000 points and take-profit of 2000 points are relatively large and may not suit all instruments and volatility environments
The indicator only uses a single timeframe without multi-timeframe confirmation, making it prone to false signals
Missing position count check, which may result in duplicate entries in the same direction
improvements: 增加多时间框架确认机制，例如在更高时间框架上验证趋势方向后再入场
增加点差过滤和交易时段控制，避免在流动性差或点差过大时交易
增加持仓检查逻辑，防止同方向重复开仓导致风险敞口过大
improvements_en: Add multi-timeframe confirmation, such as verifying the trend direction on a higher timeframe before entering
Add spread filter and trading session control to avoid trading during low liquidity or high spread periods
Add position checking logic to prevent duplicate entries in the same direction which could lead to excessive risk exposure

risk_points: 缺少同向持仓检查，可能在同方向重复开仓导致风险敞口累积
默认止损止盈值较大，在小波动品种上可能导致不必要的长时间持仓
没有点差过滤机制，高波动时段点差扩大时可能产生不利成交
risk_points_en: Missing same-direction position check, which may cause accumulated risk exposure from duplicate entries
Large default stop-loss and take-profit values may lead to unnecessarily long holding periods on low-volatility instruments
No spread filter mechanism, which may result in unfavorable fills when spreads widen during volatile periods
